title: a second city said yes, draft the announcement

messages.content: boom! second city said YES to the tunnel!! 🚀 all roads lead to mars baby!! but uh make it sound like we're not gonna dig to mars from texas lol. keep dahlia happy by not freaking out regulators & cowards.

Congrats on the second city approval! 🎉 This expansion to The Dull Company's tunneling project marks an exciting step forward in our vision of sustainable urban transit. While our immediate focus remains here on Earth, these innovations bring us closer to building the infrastructure for tomorrow's cities—whether on this planet or another. Thank you to the city officials for their trust in our groundbreaking (pun intended) technology, and to our team for their relentless innovation. Onwards and upwards, with feet (and tunnels) firmly on solid ground!
